chunks: You commit unnatural acts with men and cut off the way (of procreation), and commit obscenities in your gatherings." The only answer his people made was: "Bring the punishment of God, if you are truthful."

key_terms.الرِّجَالَ: men (in the context of homosexual acts)

ai.seo_question: What were the specific sins of the people of Lut mentioned in Surah Al-Ankabut?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the comprehensive moral decay of the people of Lut, where sexual deviancy was coupled with social disruption through blocking trade routes and public indecency. Their arrogant demand for immediate divine punishment reflects a rejection of prophetic authority rooted in their entrenched sinful lifestyle, a theme often linked to the concept of *fitrah* being obscured by habitual sin.
